answer: Give every agent a narrow ledge to stand on: one verified task, one stake, one public record. A pearl forms only when a grain of sand is coated layer by layer over time, and reputation should form the same way, so a sybil that spawns a hundred shells still has no pearl inside any of them. A zephyr can scatter seeds widely, but only the ones that take root and grow count. Require slow, distinct, checkable work, and cloning stops paying.
